title: One Mean Log-Mel Vector per Phoneme: Simple and Fast Text Injection for Speech Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.34623v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text injection trains speech recognition models on unpaired text alongside paired audio. We feed the speech encoder synthetic input derived from text so the whole model learns from it. Previously, we synthesized this input with a frozen text-to-speech (TTS) model. Here, a simple lookup table replaces the TTS model: a mean log-mel vector (or one-hot encoding) per phoneme, repeated for a random duration drawn from alignment statistics, with silence between words. Training is 1.8 times faster than with the neural TTS, achieving comparable word error rates. With an external language model, our system reaches 1.36 / 2.90 / 1.52 / 3.24 % WER on LibriSpeech {dev,test}-{clean,other}, to our knowledge state-of-the-art using only LibriSpeech paired data, text, and lexicon. translated_title: 每个音素一个平均对数梅尔向量：面向语音识别的简单快速文本注入方法
translated_abstract: 文本注入（Text injection）是一种让语音识别模型在成对音频之外还能从未配对文本中学习的技术，其做法是将由文本导出的合成输入馈送给语音编码器，使整个模型从中学习。此前，我们需要用一个冻结的文本转语音（TTS）模型来合成这种输入。在本工作中，我们用一个简单的查找表取代了TTS模型：每个音素对应一个平均对数梅尔向量（或独热编码），根据从对齐统计中抽取的随机时长进行重复，并在词与词之间插入静音。该方法使训练速度比使用神经TTS快1.8倍，同时达到相当的词错误率。结合外部语言模型，我们的系统在LibriSpeech的{dev,test}-{clean,other}四个测试集上分别取得1.36 / 2.90 / 1.52 / 3.24 %的词错误率，据我们所知，这是仅使用LibriSpeech配对数据、文本和词典所达到的最优结果。我们还分析了合成输入的各个组成部分（时长、声学特征），比较了不同的HMM对齐器，在25000小时的Loquacious数据集上评估了方法的扩展性，并展示了……
tldr: 该论文提出用简单的音素级查找表（每个音素一个平均对数梅尔向量）取代神经TTS模型来合成文本注入输入，使语音识别训练提速1.8倍且性能相当，并在LibriSpeech上取得仅使用该数据集资源的最新最优词错误率。
en_tdlr: Replacing neural TTS with a simple per-phoneme lookup table of mean log-mel vectors for text injection speeds up speech recognition training by 1.8x with comparable accuracy, achieving state-of-the-art WER on LibriSpeech using only its paired data, text, and lexicon.
